correctness.rationale: Schur complementation gives exact hub–leaf and leaf–leaf matrix entries; independent sign fourth moments give an exhaustive pair-sum variance objective. A 35,280-case exact-rational verifier supplements the proof without pretending exhaustive infinite coverage.

value.rationale: Selecting a partition under a hard budget of k independent sparse sign probes is a motivated trace-estimation design task. The theorem gives the exact risk and every optimizer for all budgets on a standard sparse star, with a budget-sensitive sharp boundary where graph-proper coloring is variance-suboptimal; a 3-probe example saves 7/64 variance. The result is a natural complete classification rather than an algorithmic speedup or a generic all-graph claim.
